note: MVP schema reference only. This is not an importable Directus snapshot or executable migration. Bootstrap, permissions and integration tests remain to be implemented. See docs/cms-schema.md and docs/AI_HANDOFF.md.

site_configuration.editor: /customize is development-only and exports JSON; it does not save repository files or CMS records.

vietnamese_labels.publish_status: Trạng thái xuất bản dự án
vietnamese_labels.og_image: Ảnh chia sẻ mạng xã hội

common_fields.enabled: boolean where supported by the frontend model
common_fields.featured: boolean where content can appear in a featured homepage block
common_fields.order: number where used by content.ts sorting; not an automatic sort_order alias
common_fields.seo_title: optional string on services, projects and articles
common_fields.seo_description: optional text on services, projects and articles
common_fields.og_image: optional file on services, projects and articles

publication_contract.services: status: draft | published | archived; frontend type currently allows status to be absent
publication_contract.articles: status: draft | published | archived; frontend requests published only
publication_contract.certificates: status: draft | published | archived; frontend requests published and enabled only

projects.note: The provider also accepts project_status/progress_status and publication_status aliases. A CMS using status for publication needs explicit mapping and integration tests. Enforce CMS publication permissions even when using a server token.

integration_notes.keys: The REST client recursively camelizes snake_case keys; it does not automatically map every relation or field type.
integration_notes.images: Single images accept a file ID, URL/path or object with id/src. Gallery arrays require compatible image objects; junction relation mapping is not implemented generically.
integration_notes.categories: Frontend category fields currently expect strings. Category collections and many-to-many relations need DTO mapping before use.
integration_notes.company_profiles: pdf_url currently must be a URL/path string; file ID/object conversion is not implemented. An empty collection still falls back to the demo profile.
integration_notes.gallery_items: The model has image/video/youtube types, but the current gallery route renders images only.
integration_notes.fallback: Provider request errors can show demo data even in production; review this policy before deployment.
integration_notes.pagination: Most list calls do not set an explicit limit or implement pagination.

permissions_note: Read access must use field-level and publication/enabled filters as appropriate. Public users must not write records or read contact requests, drafts or admin data. The current client shares token headers for reads and writes; verify least-privilege server-token access.

roles.Super Admin: Full system access for developer or owner.
roles.Website Admin: Manage CMS records and media. Branding, navigation and homepage configuration are versioned in SiteConfig instead of CMS collections.
roles.Content Editor: Manage assigned public content and media with restricted publication permissions.
roles.Viewer: Read-only access to permitted CMS records.

publish_revalidation.status: Next.js endpoint exists; Directus Flow is not provisioned by this file. Verify collection/path coverage during integration.
